why_vendored: The fixture validation gate must run offline and against a pinned contract. Fetching the bundle at test time would make the gate's verdict depend on whichever upstream revision happened to be HEAD, so a fixture could start failing on a day nothing in this repo changed, or keep passing after upstream tightened a constraint.
refresh: Re-copy the file, update the commit and sha256 here, then re-run the fixture gate and record what moved. Never edit the vendored copy in place: a locally patched schema that validates our own fixtures proves nothing.
